answer.reason: The verses only list Harim's name or his sons in returnee rosters, lists of those who took foreign wives, wall-repairer lists and a list of signatories, and state no deed or event of Harim himself beyond what the summary says.
doubts: EZR 10:31, NEH 3:11 and NEH 10:27 may refer to different men or families named Harim; the verses only list them.
